android.desc:
Local Lock is an Android app with the only goal of being a secure, locked, no-third party, completely local open source password saving app.
Very useful for less important frequently changing secure password storage

Features
- Easy to use simple UI
- Bio-metric authentication (required)
- All data is stored locally
- No third party integration (no ads, no tracking, no analytics)
- Works offline
- Secure with a lock screen PIN optionally
- Passwords are encrypted using AES-256 before being stored
- PIN based authentication
- Easily copy passwords to clipboard
- Easily reset PIN if forgotten
- Dark mode support
- Additional fields to store notes

Complete project code is Open Source to entrust security and transparency
Check out the code at - https://github.com/PriyavKaneria/LocalLock
